actions.intent: Remove silent post-tool turns while bounding automatic recovery work.
actions.pre_state: A continuation after tool execution finishes with no tool calls and no non-whitespace visible text; the current user query has fewer than two automatic nudge attempts.
actions.post_state: A continuation request carrying the recovery nudge is submitted and the per-user-query counter is incremented; no automatic nudge is submitted after the two-attempt budget is exhausted.
actions.validation: The interactive-hook test observes a second send containing the exact recovery nudge after an empty continuation.
actions.description: Recover an interactive continuation that follows tool execution but ends without visible text by issuing a bounded recovery nudge through the normal continuation path.

actions.intent: Prevent out-of-range percentage input from turning a bounded preload budget into an oversized or effectively unconditional preload.
actions.pre_state: The new percentage policy can be bypassed by hand-editing or otherwise supplying a value above 100 after static schema validation; the derived budget would otherwise exceed the whole context window.
actions.post_state: Declarative validation accepts only 0-100, and runtime input above 100 is clamped to 100 before token-budget calculation; non-finite and non-positive values still select the no-preload branch.
actions.validation: The generated and source schemas declare minimum 0 and maximum 100, and the client test supplies 200 and asserts a full-context budget rather than a budget above the context window.
actions.description: Defend the percentage invariant at both the declarative settings boundary and runtime so a hand-edited value above 100 cannot allocate a budget larger than the full context window.

actions.intent: Bound each cache-warming provider request to one output token without permanently reducing the normal completion budget or triggering repeated one-token prefill continuations.
actions.module_role: Request-parameter isolation at the boundary between background cache maintenance and foreground model completion.
actions.pre_state: The warming worker aliases the model's extra-parameter mapping, overwrites its max_tokens entry with 1, and the normal send path later consumes that same mapping.
actions.post_state: The warming worker uses a distinct kwargs mapping with max_tokens=1, while the model's extra_params retains its configured entries, such as the normal max_tokens budget, for later requests.
actions.validation: The parent and pinned diff plus the call sites provide a static invariant oracle: the warming completion consumes the copied kwargs while the foreground path still consumes model.extra_params. Existing cache-option tests cover activation only; a mocked-provider regression test for both the one-token warm ping and preserved normal budget is absent.
actions.description: Create request-local cache-warming kwargs before applying the one-token maintenance cap, preserving the model's configured parameters for subsequent foreground and prefill completions.

actions.intent: Prevent a tool-execution path from terminating without a user-facing explanation when the first post-tool response is empty.
actions.pre_state: At least one tool call has completed, the next stream has no tool calls, and it emits no non-whitespace content.
actions.post_state: The loop sends the recovery nudge as the next request, clears the armed-after-tool state, and continues; a visible response can then complete the session.
actions.validation: The legacy-session test asserts three stream calls, the exact nudge payload on the third call, tool request/response events, and the final agent message; the non-interactive regression test confirms the additional recovery call.
actions.description: In the session execution loop, recover from an empty response immediately following completed tool calls by sending a dedicated nudge before allowing normal completion.

actions.intent: Make deferred-resource preloading an explicit, mode-aware session budget policy.
actions.pre_state: No configuration value reaches core session startup to size deferred-tool preloading, so startup has no user-selectable percentage policy.
actions.post_state: A threshold percentage is available to startup with default 10; ordinary CLI sessions receive the configured value, while bare and safe sessions receive 0.
actions.validation: CLI tests assert configured forwarding at 25, default 10, and forced 0 in safe and bare modes; the settings schema supplies the declared numeric contract.
actions.description: Expose a session-start deferred-tool preload percentage, carry it from user settings into core configuration, default it to 10, and disable the policy in CLI bare/safe modes.

actions.intent: Avoid spending correction-model work on an invalid edit request and make the repair precondition explicit.
actions.pre_state: An edit invocation reaches self-correction with old_string missing or containing only whitespace.
actions.post_state: Execution returns an INVALID_TOOL_PARAMS error without invoking the LLM edit fixer and tells the agent to inspect the target with ReadFile before supplying an exact search string.
actions.validation: The edit test uses whitespace-only old_string and asserts that the fixer is not called, the error type is INVALID_TOOL_PARAMS, and the returned message includes ReadFile guidance.
actions.description: Reject a blank or whitespace-only edit search string before the expensive LLM correction path is invoked and return a localized instruction to reread the target before retrying.

actions.intent: Make the local Unix stdio descriptor invariant and its non-regression requirements directly testable.
actions.module_role: Unix local stdio launch integration oracle
actions.pre_state: The launch policy needs coverage proving both descriptor exclusion and preservation of protocol, argument, environment, cwd, parent-ownership, fallback, and exec-failure behavior.
actions.post_state: The checked-in Unix tests distinguish an unfiltered launch from the policy-enabled launch and provide assertions for server/descendant exclusion and preserved behavior across all three launch forms.
actions.validation: The integration tests assert control presence, policy-enabled absence, MCP initialize/list/call results, preserved stderr/cwd/environment/arguments, unchanged parent F_GETFD state, and an error for a missing interpreter.
parameters: absolute, relative, and shell-fallback launch forms
actions.description: Add an executable regression oracle for descriptor isolation and for the compatibility behaviors that must survive the new process boundary.

actions.intent: Keep active tool, code, file, or similar payloads usable while removing empty text artifacts that can trigger request validation failures.
actions.pre_state: An outgoing part has text equal to the empty string, either alongside another active payload or as its only meaningful field.
actions.post_state: The empty text key is removed from payload-bearing parts; text-only empty parts are filtered; other payload-bearing parts remain.
actions.validation: The implementation contains separate payload-preservation and empty-part filtering branches, but no dedicated regression assertion for this newly added sanitizer behavior is present in the pinned commit tests.
actions.description: Normalize outgoing content parts so an empty text field cannot invalidate a payload-bearing part or remain as a truly empty text-only part.

actions.intent: Make a failed localized edit actionable by distinguishing an exact-match miss and directing the agent to inspect current content.
actions.pre_state: A nonblank edit search string produces zero matches in the current file.
actions.post_state: The tool reports an exact-match failure and advises rereading the target/current lines before retrying; the correction path remains available for valid nonblank input according to its existing policy.
actions.validation: The edit regression test checks that both LLM-facing content and display output contain the new exact-match wording.
actions.description: Replace vague no-occurrence edit feedback with exact-match guidance that points the agent to current file content before retrying.

actions.intent: Remove a stale materialized default from existing configuration files so the new policy takes effect after upgrade without clobbering user-selected resource budgets.
actions.module_role: Versioned configuration migration and user-choice preservation
actions.pre_state: A versioned configuration below schema v47 may contain compression.threshold_tokens: 256000 copied from the old template or doctor seeding; the same field may instead contain another explicit positive integer or null.
actions.post_state: The v47 migration deletes the field only when its raw value equals exactly 256000, allowing the new DEFAULT_CONFIG None to apply; other explicit caps, explicit null, and unrelated configuration values remain intact.
actions.validation: The new registry entry and the existing equality-gated deletion helper directly encode the exact-value guard. The generic upgrade property test dynamically includes registered migration versions and checks latest-version convergence, user-value preservation, idempotence, and reapplication stability, but does not directly generate threshold_tokens: 256000.
actions.description: Migrate configurations that persisted the temporary 256000 default so they inherit the new ratio-only default, without rewriting an intentional cap or explicit null.

actions.intent: Translate a percentage resource policy into a concrete token budget before deferred-resource reconciliation.
actions.pre_state: A threshold policy exists, but startup has not derived the number of schema tokens that may be declared up front; explicit context capacity may be absent.
actions.post_state: When deferred discovery is available and the threshold and context are usable, the registry receives floor(contextWindow*boundedThreshold/100); otherwise the budgeted preload call is omitted.
actions.validation: Client tests cover the model-limit fallback at 10%, an explicit 50,000-token context at 10%, threshold 0, non-finite threshold, over-100 input, and missing discovery surface.
actions.description: Convert an accepted positive threshold and available model capacity into a floored token budget at session start, using the configured context window or model-limit fallback and skipping unsupported branches.

actions.intent: Make retry guidance visible at the current context boundary without invalidating or expanding the stable system-instruction prefix.
actions.pre_state: A retry follows a thought-only or no-response-text invalid stream; request contents may end in a model turn, an ordinary user turn, or a function-response user turn, and hooks may replace contents.
actions.post_state: System instruction is unchanged; the retry nudge is present at the end of valid contents, role alternation is preserved with a synthetic model bridge when required, and an existing final-turn nudge is not duplicated.
actions.validation: GeminiChat tests assert unchanged systemInstruction, nudge placement in contents, reapplication after hook-modified contents, handling of empty/model/function-response histories, and deduplication.
actions.description: Place invalid-stream retry guidance at the end of request contents while preserving API role ordering and hook modifications, instead of mutating the stable system instruction.

actions.intent: Avoid incremental declaration-list and prompt-prefix churn for a small deferred set while retaining on-demand discovery for a set that exceeds the budget.
actions.pre_state: Deferred tool schemas are hidden behind discovery, and the registry has no combined footprint decision; bundled and MCP candidates may coexist with already-revealed, visible, or always-loaded tools.
actions.post_state: The registry estimates the union of eligible deferred schemas as ceil(serialized-schema-characters/CHARS_PER_TOKEN) and reveals all eligible unrevealed candidates iff that estimate is within budget; otherwise no candidate is newly revealed. Visible and always-loaded tools are excluded, while already-revealed candidates still count.
actions.validation: Registry tests cover fit, overflow, bundled-plus-MCP all-or-nothing behavior, already-revealed accounting, visible-tool exclusion, and always-loaded exclusion; declaration-path code shows that revealed schemas enter the function-declaration list.
actions.description: Estimate the complete eligible deferred-tool schema union and reveal every candidate only when the combined estimate fits the supplied budget; preserve full deferral on overflow.

actions.intent: Apply the resource decision at the stable startup boundary so preloaded schemas are declared initially and are not later reintroduced as deferred reminders.
actions.pre_state: Startup would resolve deferred reminders without a budget stage, so any preload decision would either be absent from initial declarations or require a later declaration-list change.
actions.post_state: Preload runs after warm/resume reconciliation and before reminder setup; revealed tools are included in the initial declarations and filtered from the deferred reminder, while the existing no-discovery eager-reveal branch and late-registration deferral remain intact.
actions.validation: The client startup call site establishes the stage ordering; reminder and declaration consumers show how revealed state is applied; client tests cover the preload stage and the no-discovery skip branch. No direct prompt-cache measurement is present.
actions.description: Run the budgeted reveal after registry warm/resume handling and before deferred-reminder construction so the initial declaration list and reminder reflect the same revealed state without introducing a mid-session preload mutation.

actions.intent: Remove an unintended fixed token ceiling that makes compression fire at a non-proportional point across heterogeneous context windows, while preserving an explicit user-controlled absolute cost ceiling.
actions.module_role: Compression budget policy and configuration defaulting
actions.pre_state: When compression.threshold_tokens is absent, the defaulted configuration supplies 256000; agent construction passes that value as an absolute cap and the compressor lowers the ratio/model trigger to min(ratio_trigger, 256000).
actions.post_state: When compression.threshold_tokens is absent, the canonical value is None and the effective trigger is the ratio/model-derived threshold with no absolute cap; a positive explicit cap still lowers the trigger and remains durable across model switches.
actions.validation: The changed compressor test covers 128000 and 1000000 context windows and asserts no default cap plus equality with the ratio-only trigger; the explicit-cap test asserts a 200000 cap survives a switch. Gateway-cache and TUI tests verify that consumers use the canonical default and distinguish explicit positive caps.
actions.description: Make the absolute compression-trigger cap opt-in by changing the canonical default and its seeded template from 256000 to null/None, while retaining explicit positive caps as lower-of ratio-versus-absolute controls.

actions.intent: Prevent unrelated parent file descriptors from leaking into a local stdio extension process tree while preserving the explicit transport stdio.
actions.pre_state: The local launch command has piped standard streams and a new process group but leaves descriptor policy at Inherit, so inheritable parent descriptors can be inherited by the server and by commands it launches.
actions.post_state: On Unix, local stdio launches enforce a stdio-only inheritance boundary: the server and descendants inherit the explicit transport stdio but not unrelated inheritable parent descriptors, with existing arguments, environment, cwd, process-group, and exec-error behavior preserved.
actions.validation: The added Unix integration oracle first proves that an unfiltered control launch sees the pipe, socket, and file sentinels, then verifies [false, false, false] in both the local server and a close_fds=False descendant across absolute, relative, and shell-fallback launches; it also checks MCP round-trip behavior, parent descriptor ownership, and failed-exec reporting.
parameters: unrelated inheritable pipe, socket, and file descriptors
Unix server and descendant process tree
actions.description: Configure the local Unix stdio extension-process launch so unrelated descriptors inherited by the orchestrator do not cross into the extension server or its descendants, while the explicit stdio transport and existing launch settings remain usable.

actions.intent: Prevent side effects and post-execution hooks for prepared tool calls after a later preflight abort while preserving one explicit aborted outcome for each recorded call.
actions.module_role: Abort-aware deferred executor for a parallel tool-call batch
actions.pre_state: A tool call has passed validation and preflight and is stored for deferred execution; before its deferred entry runs, another preflight aborts the shared run signal.
actions.post_state: The deferred entry does not invoke the tool or after-execution hook; it emits a tool_execution_end error outcome with "Operation aborted", and the common ordered path persists the corresponding error tool-result message.
actions.validation: The committed regression test aborts in the second preflight, then observes zero external executions and zero extension tool_result hooks, two matching start/end call identities, error end events for both calls, and two source-ordered "Operation aborted" toolResult messages.
actions.description: Recheck cancellation when a prepared parallel-call entry is finally invoked. If the batch was aborted after preflight, convert that recorded entry into an error outcome and execution-end event so the existing ordered path can persist a corresponding tool result without starting the side effect or post-execution hook.

actions.intent: Prevent cancelled in-flight tool turns from persisting as transcript state and avoid unnecessary follow-up work.
actions.pre_state: A prepared query has been sent, the model has appended a tool-call turn, all applicable model-initiated tools are terminally cancelled, and current history is longer than the saved query checkpoint.
actions.post_state: History is truncated to the saved checkpoint; cancellation response parts are not appended and no continuation request is emitted.
actions.validation: Interactive stream regression tests verify that addHistory is not called, history returns to the pre-model length, and the model stream is not called again for one or multiple cancelled tools.
actions.description: When every model-initiated tool in an interactive turn is cancelled, restore the conversation to the checkpoint taken before the current query instead of recording cancellation responses as a new user turn or sending another request.

workflows.name: session-tool-continuation-recovery
workflows.description: The session loop arms recovery after completed tools, checks the next response for visible content, and nudges once before allowing normal completion.
workflows.goal: Ensure a tool execution is followed by an explanatory model response even when the first continuation is empty.
workflows.entry_state: The session has completed one or more model-initiated tool calls and is about to process the next model stream.
workflows.exit_state: The model emits visible text after the recovery request or the session follows its normal completion/failure path.
unresolved_or_deferred: The implementation arms one recovery nudge per completed-tool cycle but does not expose a numeric retry budget; repeated empty output after the nudge follows the normal completion path.

workflows.name: interactive-tool-turn-bounding
workflows.description: The interactive path has two event-dependent recovery branches: remove a cancelled tool turn from durable history, or recover a silent successful tool continuation with a bounded nudge.
workflows.goal: Keep interactive tool turns bounded and recoverable without growing invalid or silent conversation state.
workflows.entry_state: A user query is being processed; the model may request tools, produce an empty continuation, or have all requested tools cancelled.
workflows.exit_state: Cancelled turns are absent from durable history, or a post-tool continuation produces visible completion or stops after the automatic-nudge budget.
unresolved_or_deferred: The two actions are predicate-selected branches of the same coordinator rather than a mandatory sequence: rollback applies to all-cancelled tool turns, while nudging applies to a successful tool continuation with no visible response. The tests do not establish a cross-branch ordering.

workflows.name: restore_proportional_compression_budget_and_upgrade_stale_configs
workflows.description: Establish the ratio-driven default for compression triggers, then reconcile versioned configurations that persisted the temporary 256000 default; leave explicit absolute caps available as an opt-in branch and verify the existing cache/live-session consumers follow the canonical value.
workflows.goal: Compression follows the configured ratio and model/window semantics by default, while an explicit absolute threshold remains available and old seeded configurations stop imposing the stale fixed cap.
workflows.entry_state: The parent v46 policy supplies a 256000 cap when threshold_tokens is absent, templates can persist that value, and a large-window session can compact at the fixed cap instead of its proportional trigger.
workflows.exit_state: The v47 default and template represent no absolute cap, fresh and live configurations treat absence as ratio-only, versioned old literals are removed, and explicit positive caps still clamp triggers and survive model switches.
unresolved_or_deferred: The migration branch is conditional: it runs for versioned configurations below v47 whose raw value is exactly 256000; unversioned files and current-version explicit values remain outside this stale-default rewrite.

No changed test directly constructs a v46 file with threshold_tokens: 256000 and asserts both deletion and preservation of alternate values; exact behavior is supported by the implementation guard and indirectly by the generic migration properties.
The targeted runtime test suite was not executed because the repository environment could not activate with the locked dependency file.

workflows.name: bounded-startup-deferred-resource-preload
workflows.description: Establish a bounded percentage policy, harden its domain, derive a token budget from actual context capacity, atomically reveal the complete eligible deferred set only when it fits, and construct the initial declarations/reminder from the resulting state.
workflows.goal: Bound the amount of deferred-resource schema declared up front by a percentage of available context while avoiding partial preload and preserving on-demand discovery when the union is too large.
workflows.entry_state: The parent startup path hides ordinary deferred tools behind discovery without a context-scaled preload policy or combined schema-footprint gate.
workflows.exit_state: For a valid positive policy and fitting current deferred set, all eligible deferred schemas are in the initial declaration list and absent from the deferred reminder; for over-budget, disabled, invalid, or unavailable branches, no invalid budgeted preload occurs and the existing deferral/eager-reveal behavior remains.
unresolved_or_deferred: The no-preload branches are runtime predicates, not separate implementation stages: discovery unavailable, threshold non-finite or <=0, invalid context, and an over-budget union preserve the existing non-preload behavior.
Tools registered after startup remain deferred until a later session start; the design explicitly avoids calling this policy from mid-session setTools synchronization.
The prompt KV-cache stability benefit is reasoned from declaration-list ordering and design comments but has no direct end-to-end cache-hit measurement in the pinned episode.
The always-on-context warning named in the issue title is outside this workflow because its parent/current implementation is unchanged.

workflows.name: parallel-preflight-abort-reconciliation
workflows.description: When sequential preflight of a concurrent tool batch aborts the run after a call has been prepared, reconcile the already-recorded deferred entry into a standardized aborted result before returning the batch.
workflows.goal: Return a cancellation-consistent tool batch after a later preflight abort, with no deferred side effect and a result artifact for every recorded call.
workflows.entry_state: An assistant message contains multiple tool calls; preflight is sequential, at least one call is prepared for deferred parallel execution, and a later preflight aborts the shared run.
workflows.exit_state: All recorded calls have tool_execution_end error outcomes and source-ordered toolResult messages, with no prepared tool execution or post-execution result hook after the abort.
unresolved_or_deferred: The patch preserves the existing break after an immediate aborted preparation; no evidence shows placeholder results for tool calls that were never started or recorded before that break.
The committed test is the direct validation oracle; no separate workflow stage is needed for a second independent validator.

workflows.name: edit-request-budget-guard
workflows.description: The edit path handles two predicate-dependent failures: reject blank selectors before correction-model work, or return exact-match guidance for nonblank selectors that do not match current content.
workflows.goal: Prevent invalid localized edits from consuming correction work and provide actionable repair guidance for stale or mismatched input.
workflows.entry_state: An edit invocation supplies either a blank search string or a nonblank string with zero matches.
workflows.exit_state: Blank input fails before LLM correction, or a no-match error tells the agent to reread current target lines and retry with an exact match.
unresolved_or_deferred: The two edit actions are mutually exclusive predicate branches for a given invocation. The wording-only confirmation-attribution change is recorded as evidence but is not promoted to a separate semantic action.

workflows.name: local_unix_stdio_descriptor_lifecycle
workflows.description: At the local stdio extension-process boundary, apply the Unix-only descriptor guard and then validate that the server tree receives only transport stdio without regressing communication, launch compatibility, parent ownership, or failure reporting.
workflows.goal: Ensure local Unix stdio extension servers and their descendants cannot inherit unrelated orchestrator descriptors while the stdio transport and established launch contract remain functional.
workflows.entry_state: A local stdio server is launched with the shared command's default inherited-descriptor policy, so unrelated inheritable descriptors may enter the server process tree and the regression boundary is not covered by an end-to-end oracle.
workflows.exit_state: The local Unix launch path enforces stdio-only descriptor inheritance, server and descendant probes report no unrelated sentinels, and the integration oracle confirms MCP communication, launch variants, arguments, environment, cwd, parent descriptor ownership, and exec-failure reporting.
unresolved_or_deferred: The implementation is gated by cfg(unix); the commit explicitly leaves Windows unrelated-handle inheritance to a future shared-spawn handle allowlist, and the added integration test is Unix-only.
The issue bundle contains no issue body, comments, timeline, or linked pull-request metadata, so acceptance criteria beyond the local implementation and commit testing note are unavailable.

workflows.name: preserve_foreground_budget_during_cache_keepalive
workflows.description: For an enabled prompt-cache keepalive flow, isolate the one-token maintenance override from the shared model configuration so delayed cache pings remain bounded and later prefill-capable completions retain their normal output budget.
workflows.goal: Keep the prompt cache alive with bounded maintenance calls while preserving the foreground completion budget and avoiding a one-token prefill loop.
workflows.entry_state: Prompt-cache keepalive is enabled for a cache-capable model; send_message schedules or runs cache warming before the foreground send, and the parent implementation shares the model extra-parameter mapping with the warming request.
workflows.exit_state: Each warming request receives max_tokens=1 through a local kwargs copy, the model extra_params mapping remains unchanged for foreground and prefill-capable calls, and the length-continuation path is no longer forced into one-token responses by cache warming.
unresolved_or_deferred: The checkout has no targeted regression test that mocks the warming provider and asserts both the one-token warm request and preservation of the next normal request's configured max_tokens.

ModelSettings declares extra_params as Optional[dict], while the pinned expression calls dict(...) without an explicit None guard; built-in cache-capable settings inspected here provide mappings, but the custom or None case remains unresolved.
The cache-disabled and zero-ping early-return branches are unchanged by the commit and are not represented as separate change actions.

workflows.name: model-retry-request-integrity
workflows.description: The model request path adapts invalid-stream retry guidance to the current contents and then normalizes outgoing parts before the API call.
workflows.goal: Bound retry guidance and preserve valid request-content contracts at the model boundary.
workflows.entry_state: A retry request contains an invalid-stream condition or outgoing parts with empty text artifacts.
workflows.exit_state: Retry guidance is appended to valid request contents, the stable system instruction is preserved, and payload-bearing parts are not rejected solely because of an empty text key.
unresolved_or_deferred: The sanitizer is in the final request-construction path, but the pinned commit adds no direct regression assertion for its new empty-part branches. The edge captures request construction order, not a requirement that every retry contain an empty part.
